name: hellboy-prod
description: A terminal agent bridge for a running music production session.

scripts.build: npm run build -w mock-live && npm run build -w bridge && npm run build -w installer
scripts.test: npm run build -w mock-live && npm run build -w bridge && node --test "bridge/dist/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.bundle: npm run bundle -w bridge && npm run bundle -w installer
